  "w01": "On the third night of the storm, Elias found a bottle wedged between the lighthouse rocks, glowing faintly in his lantern. Inside was blue paper, dry despite the sea. “To whoever keeps the light,” it read, “I have counted your beam from my window for forty years. Tonight my ship comes home, and I want you to know you were never alone on that rock.” There was no name, only a drawing of a gull. Elias climbed the tower and searched the black water. At dawn, a fishing boat entered the harbor, its sail patched with red cloth. An old woman stood at the bow, waving not at the village but at him. Elias lifted his lantern, though the sun had risen, and waved back.",
  "w02": "凌晨四点，城市把喧嚣折进深邃的巷子。便利店的白光落在空荡街口，外卖车掠过积水，像一枚匆忙的逗号。环卫工挥动竹帚，将昨夜残存的纸杯与落叶归拢；高楼仍有零星窗灯，照着未眠的人。远处首班地铁在地下低鸣，早餐铺掀起蒸笼，白雾缓缓升起。天边尚未透亮，城市已在寂静里换好新的一页。",
  "w03": "- Recursion is when a set of instructions uses a smaller version of the same task.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a tiny box with a prize.\n- The instructions must include a stopping point, like that final tiny box, or they would continue forever."
